name: Mabe's Strawberries
description: In Ellerbe, NC, Mabe's Strawberries raises Strawberries and Blueberries on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
